citation.title: Positive end expiratory pressure titrated by transpulmonary pressure improved oxygenation and respiratory mechanics in acute respiratory distress syndrome patients with intra-abdominal hypertension

provenance.quote: The exclusion criteria included age younger than 18 years or older than 85 years
The 15 patients included in the study were intubated and received invasive mechanical ventilation.
ARDS patients admitted to the intensive care unit (ICU) of the Zhongda Hospital
PEEP set to achieve a transpulmonary pressure of 0–10 cmH2O at end expiration, according to a sliding scale based on PaO2 and FiO2 in PEEP titrated by Ptp method, as Talmor described.

Arterial pressure of O2/fraction of inspired oxygen (PaO2/FiO2) was much higher under PEEP titrated by Ptp when compared with PEEP titrated by ARDSnet protocol in ARDS patients with IAH ((27.2±4.0) cmHg vs. (20.9± 5.0) cmHg).
Of 15 eligible ARDS patients receiving mechanical ventilation, seven ARDS patients with IAH and eight ARDS patients without IAH were included in the study

crossover_order.value: A randomized, crossover study was conducted. subgroup_flags.classification_notes: ARDS subgroup: all patients had ARDS by inclusion. Obesity subgroup: mean BMI 23-25 kg/m2, not obese. Timing subgroup: enrolled within 72h of ARDS onset but not necessarily within 48h, hence unclear. PTP target: end-expiratory Ptp 0-10 cmH2O, absolute subtraction.

reported_subgroups.result_verbatim: In ARDS patients with IAH, the PaO2/FiO2... improved significantly than ARDSnet protocol. In ARDS patients without IAH, there were no significant differences of PEEP induced change of gas exchange between PEEP guided by Ptp and ARDSnet protocol.

provenance.quote: In ARDS patients with IAH, the PaO2/FiO2, A–aDO2 and SaO2 with PEEP guided by Ptp improved significantly than ARDSnet protocol. In ARDS patients without IAH, there were no significant differences of PEEP induced change of gas exchange between PEEP guided by Ptp and ARDSnet protocol.
provenance.location: Results, Effects of PEEP on gas exchange, para 1

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: No overlapping cohort identified. Enrolment dates Aug 2011-Apr 2012, single centre in Nanjing, China. Compared with COHORTS.md clusters; none match. Registration number not reported.
unclear_items: ARDSnet PEEP-FiO2 table not specified as low or high; coded as ardsnet_low_peep_fio2_table based on low PEEP values but this is inferred.
28-day mortality reported as percentages (25% for ARDS, 33% for ARDS+IAH) without exact event counts; percentages are inconsistent with denominators (33% of 7 not an integer).
Crs, Ccw, Cl, and VD/VT at each PEEP condition only presented in Figure 3; numeric values not extractable from text.
Timing from ARDS onset reported as 'less than 72 hours', so timing_subgroup classified as unclear because it may be >48h.
Balloon calibration method inferred as Baydur occlusion test based on reference 19, but no explicit occlusion test described.
Crossover sequence order not described in detail; only stated as randomized.
